classification.difficultyReason: Identify equal-area regions, count the shaded fraction, and convert it to a percentage; the triangular partitions require recognising eighths.

content.prompt: What percentage of each shape is shaded?

spec.description: A square divided into 100 equal cells, all shaded.
spec.answerVisibility: Source shading only; no numerical answer is printed.

spec.description: A 10 by 10 square grid. The first seven cells of each upper six rows and the first six cells of each lower four rows are shaded.
spec.mathematics: 6 times 7 plus 4 times 6 gives 66 shaded cells out of 100.
spec.answerVisibility: Source shading only; no numerical answer is printed.

spec.description: A square divided into ten equal vertical strips; the leftmost four are shaded.

spec.description: A square divided into ten equal vertical strips; strips 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 from the left are shaded.
spec.answerVisibility: Source shading only; no numerical answer is printed.

template.shadeReason: The alternating shaded strips identify the requested portion of the square.

spec.description: Four equal smaller squares each have a diagonal from upper left to lower right. The lower-left triangle of the upper-left, upper-right and lower-right smaller squares is shaded. The fraction-grid template cannot express triangular subdivisions.
spec.mathematics: Three of eight equal triangles are shaded.
spec.answerVisibility: Source subdivision and shading only; no numerical answer is printed.

answer.worked:
Three of the eight equal triangles are shaded.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Percentage shaded}&=\frac{3}{8}\times100\%\\\text{Percentage shaded}&=37.5\%\end{align*}$$
